tools.name: onairos_connect
tools.description: Open the Onairos login page in the user's browser so they can sign in and connect their accounts. This returns immediately — tell the user to complete the flow in their browser, then use onairos_sync to fetch the results.

tools.name: onairos_sync
tools.description: Fetch the user's Onairos personality traits after they completed the browser flow from onairos_connect. Call this after the user confirms they finished the sign-in. Returns personality traits that should be saved to USER.md memory.
